description: A man in a dark blue military-style uniform with red epaulettes and red trouser stripe holds a cap and faces a woman with long dark hair, a red flower in it, in a black bodice and layered red-and-black ruffled skirt, hands on hips. They stand in a sunlit plaza with colonnaded pale buildings, with a uniformed figure at the right edge and onlookers in the background. The painting is loose oil-style brushwork, filling the whole frame, with no visible text.
